issues.title: Establish project identity and open-source release policy
issues.description: Record repository owner, original working name and provenance of existing code; adopt the chosen license with correct attribution.
acceptance_criteria: License and attribution committed before public release
private security reporting and contribution policy documented.

issues.title: Restore a runnable web application and routing demo
issues.description: Introduce React/TypeScript build and replace missing web asset references in both development and Rust startup paths.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout can build and open the UI
route request and no-feasible-route errors display

issues.title: Add SQLite migrations and deterministic seed data
issues.description: Create versioned schema with operation IDs, entity versions, actors, item units, ledger, reservations, deliveries, and audit.
acceptance_criteria: Empty database migrates and seeds repeatably
synthetic fixture covers three stock sites/six items/three vehicles

issues.title: Expand CI to Rust, web, and route contract parity
issues.description: Add locked builds, cargo tests, frontend checks, and shared request/result fixtures for the Rust and JavaScript solvers.
acceptance_criteria: CI compiles the application and compares successful, invalid, closure, and ferry cases

issues.title: Build catalog APIs and inventory workspace
issues.description: Create location/item/vehicle forms and a searchable inventory table with explicit units and transport-node mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Create/edit validation works through API and UI
duplicate SKU and unknown nodes fail clearly

issues.title: Implement transactional stock ledger and balances
issues.description: Implement receipt, consumption, and compensating adjustment events with scaled quantities and materialized balances.
acceptance_criteria: adjustments are excluded from consumption rates.

issues.title: Add stock observations and versioned reconciliation
issues.description: Capture physical counts as observations and apply reviewed differences as explicit ledger adjustments.
acceptance_criteria: Count with stale balance version becomes conflict
coordinator correction records reason and actor.

issues.title: Add CSV preview, validation, commit, and export
issues.description: Support documented item/stock import templates and versioned previews.

issues.title: Implement users, sessions, and role enforcement
issues.description: Add Viewer/Operator/Coordinator/Admin roles with secure sessions and permissions on all domain mutations.
acceptance_criteria: secure password hashing, CSRF defense, expiry and login limits verified

issues.title: Expose audit history and freshness indicators
issues.description: Write audit events in domain transactions and display entity timelines plus last-confirmed timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: failed writes do not appear successful
stale/missing observation labels persist in UI.

issues.title: Implement coverage and replenishment estimates
issues.description: Calculate trailing usage, manual fallback, days of cover, reorder threshold, and target replenishment.
acceptance_criteria: Independent 120/40 example produces 3 days cover and 160 suggested cases
units, rounding and inbound horizon tested.

issues.title: Build shortage queue with traceable calculations
issues.description: Rank shortage alerts and expose calculation inputs, policy settings, and freshness.
acceptance_criteria: User can inspect and edit rate/lead/safety/target policy by role
no unsupported confidence percentage is shown.

issues.title: Validate cargo and draft delivery proposals
issues.description: Create one-source/one-destination drafts with line items and payload mass/volume totals.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown units or missing cargo conversion block approval
route weight includes vehicle tare plus payload.

issues.title: Connect route planning and scenario comparison
issues.description: Connect draft delivery to existing routing engine and display route, constraints, waits, revision, and ETA.
acceptance_criteria: synthetic graph and ETA assumptions clearly labeled.

issues.title: Approve deliveries with atomic reservations
issues.description: Approve against current stock, graph, delivery, and vehicle versions in one transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Competing approvals cannot over-reserve stock or vehicle interval
identical operation retry returns same result

issues.title: Dispatch and receive deliveries with conserved quantities
issues.description: Implement dispatch, partial receipts, completion, returns, and discrepancy reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: partial receipt adds only received amount

issues.title: Build delivery execution and exception screens
issues.description: Expose permitted transitions with role-aware controls and clear exception state.
acceptance_criteria: 120/40 replenishment scenario can be completed entirely through UI

issues.title: Add browser app shell and bounded data cache
issues.description: Cache application assets and authorized snapshot in service worker/IndexedDB.

issues.title: Implement durable outbox and idempotent sync API
issues.description: Queue field observations/receipt claims and synchronize by stable IDs and server cursor.
acceptance_criteria: changed payload with reused ID conflicts

issues.title: Build sync status and conflict resolution workflow
issues.description: Show queued, accepted, rejected, and conflicting operations with permitted resolution actions.
acceptance_criteria: Two-device stale count requires reviewed adjustment
manual retry works without Background Sync

issues.title: Verify the complete replenishment and outage scenario
issues.description: Add browser and API integration coverage for the complete demo and core failure paths.
acceptance_criteria: concurrency, replay, partial receipts, graph changes, restart and offline conflict cases pass with recorded evidence.

issues.title: Package deployment, migrations, backup, and restore
issues.description: Provide single-service container and persistent database volume with local quickstart and remote TLS guidance.

issues.title: Complete accessibility and performance review
issues.description: Review keyboard operation, labels, contrast, narrow layouts and measured performance targets.
acceptance_criteria: agreed reference-machine measurements documented against PRODUCT targets

issues.title: Publish API and contributor documentation
issues.description: Document API schemas, units, state transitions, conflict responses, installation, demo, and contribution workflow.
acceptance_criteria: fresh checkout instructions tested by another person where available

issues.title: Prepare v0.1 release and security gate
issues.description: Audit dependencies and secrets, verify release checklist, tag source, package build outputs and changelog.

issues.title: Prototype optional read-only logistics assistant
issues.description: Design provider-neutral assistant over authorized inventory/forecast/delivery reads, disabled by default.
acceptance_criteria: evaluation fixtures reject fabricated stock values.

issues.title: Pilot CSV/API integration and barcode capture
issues.description: Choose one real pilot workflow and one adapter; explore camera/barcode or external stock feed with fixture-backed contracts.

issues.title: Evaluate real-road maps and routing data
issues.description: Assess map/routing providers, data licenses, offline availability and vehicle-limit completeness using representative pilot routes.
acceptance_criteria: distinguish display maps from routing graph
retain synthetic demo without external dependencies.

issues.title: Design multi-stop fleet planning and improved forecasts
issues.description: Use pilot data to scope time windows, stop sequencing, fleet scheduling, seasonal demand and database scaling.
acceptance_criteria: ADR compares solver and storage alternatives with benchmarks
